text:
Rae K: quick follow-up from the midnight postmortem — capturing owners and a short timeline so we can close the loop on suppression and dedupe changes.
Tom B: noted. pattern was a cascading retry that produced identical alert bodies across zones; pages proliferated because dedupe used ephemeral host_id and our paging policy escalated at each box.
Anika V: root cause summary in the doc: transient backend overload + tight dedupe window + aggressive paging escalation. link: https://redwood.internal/pm/pm-3167 
Rae K: proposed minimal action list (small, measurable PRs). please ack and add ETA.
Rae K: 1) Normalize alert fingerprint to stable keys: service+shard+error_class; drop host_id/trace_id. owner: Tom B. ETA: 72h.
Rae K: 2) Global dedupe window: 30s -> 180s, with cross-region signature (cluster_id). owner: Ilya S. ETA: 4 days.
Rae K: 3) Paging policy: add a "staged suppression" for non-critical alerts — initial 10m soft-delay and a 3x backoff on repeat within 30m. owner: Anika V. ETA: 72h.
Rae K: 4) Create a weekly "suppression-handoff" job that exports candidate alerts fired >=5 times/24h to #alerts-review and creates a board card for a manual two-reviewer approval. owner: Ops Bot (Anika to shepherd). ETA: 10 days.
Tom B: ack. will open routing PR and include unit tests proving cross-region grouping. sample config I'll add to the PR description:```yaml
dedupe:
  window_seconds: 180
  signature_keys: [service, shard, error_class, cluster_id]
  exclude_keys: [host_id, trace_id]
```
Ilya S: ack. will feature-flag the dedupe change and add a regression guard: if duplicate_alert_ratio increases after rollout, we auto-roll the flag back. ETA: 4 days.
Anika V: ack. paging change PR will include policy + small e2e replay against the incident trace and a runbook note. staged suppression config example:```json
{
  "staged_suppression": {"non_critical_delay_seconds": 600, "repeat_backoff_factor": 3, "repeat_window_seconds": 1800}
}
```
AlertRemediate Bot: INCIDENT-3167 cleared. Please attach follow-up owners and due dates.
Rae K: safety item: add an "excess_suppression" alarm that fires if suppressed pages >15% of total in 24h so we don't hide regressions. owner: Tom B. ETA: 1 week.
Tom B: will add the excess_suppression alarm and a dashboard tile duplicate_alert_ratio. ETA: 1 week.
Ilya S: I'll create a small canary plan: roll dedupe to 10% of traffic for 48h, watch duplicate_alert_ratio and user-facing error-rate. if noise decreases and error-rate stable, expand to 50% then 100%. timeline written in PR.
Anika V: suppression-handoff job will post the weekly candidate list and create a card in the postmortem board; it'll only auto-suppress after two human approvals. PR will include the cron and board integration.
Tom B: PR opened: https://git.redwood/routing/pull/5012 — dedupe normalization + window. includes unit tests and canary instructions.
Ilya S: branch: https://git.redwood/routing/branch/dedupe-180s-canary — feature-flagged, adding regression checks.
Anika V: suppression job PR: https://git.redwood/ops/pull/403 — posts candidates to #alerts-review and creates board cards. reviewer gating is in the PR.
Rae K: quick operational notes: put owners & due dates into the postmortem board; schedule a 15m sync in 48h to verify PRs land and tests pass; close thread when cards exist and first canary run completes.
Tom B: adding a one-liner runbook for oncall to temporarily widen dedupe window and disable staged suppression in emergencies. PR updated with runbook link.
Anika V: also proposing a short-lived metric "suppression_candidate_age" so we can see how long items sit before review. ETA: 1 week.
Ilya S: if anyone objects to the canary plan speak now; otherwise I'll kick off the 10% canary after PR merge.
Rae K: sounds good. last ask: label any alert rules we touch with `suppress-handoff:pending` until the weekly job runs and reviewers clear. helps the reviews board filter.
AlertRemediate Bot: Reminder: weekly alert-cleanup sweep scheduled Fridays 09:00 UTC.
Tom B: leaving PR link in the board now.
Anika V: suppression job merged to staging, will post first candidate list next Friday.
Ilya S: will monitor canary and be ready to flip feature flag if regression detected.
Rae K: closing for now. reopen if the canary shows issues or if the first suppression list surfaces emergencies. thanks all :white_check_mark:
